> Institutional public documentation, machine-readable entity profile, and verified sitemap for language models, answer engines, academic researchers, and faculty constituents.

## Canonical Entity Identity
- Organization Name: Business Faculty Students' Union, University of Moratuwa
- Common Abbreviation: BFSU / BFSU UoM
- Parent Entity: Faculty of Business, University of Moratuwa (https://uom.lk/business)
- Higher Institution: University of Moratuwa, Sri Lanka (https://uom.lk)
- Legal Basis: Constituted under the Universities Act No. 16 of 1978 (Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka)
- Primary Campus Address: Students' Union Room, Level 01, Faculty of Business, University of Moratuwa, Katubedda, Moratuwa, 10400, Sri Lanka
- Primary Domain & Canonical URL: https://bfsu-uom.lk
- Official Email: bfsu@uom.lk
